{{Quote|On the contrary, he's already made contingency plans for defeat. Ten years ago he had sleeper groups of the best of his cloned warriors scattered around the Empire and New Republic, ready to form the nuclei of local resistance forces should Bastion and Coruscant fall. Men who loved their homes and their land and their worlds, and who would give their lives in their defense.|Voss Parck|<ref name="VotF" />}}
During his [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] established several '''sleeper cells''' throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. These cells were made up of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] grown in [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]]. [[Jenth-44]], located on [[Pakrik Minor]], was one such cell, comprised of clones of [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]].
